text:
maria.sre: :rotating_light: SLO alert - hosted-infer-usw2 - 5xx fraction jumped from 0.8% -> 6.4% in last 10m. P99 latency also up. Alert linked: https://console.redwood/slo/hosted-infer-usw2
observability-bot: Alert 1802003456 triggered: slo_burn/high_5xx_fraction (window=10m)
jordan: Noticed a couple of customer support tickets reporting timeouts and 502s around the same time. @ryan-support any examples?
ryan-support: Customer A sent curl reproducer: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate` -> 504 after 15s. Also saw repeated retries from their service.
ashwin (ashwin): Could be an auth rotation mismatch. We rotated hosted API tokens 6h ago; some clients may be retrying with old tokens which cause 401 -> client retry storm, then upstream backpressure causing 5xx. Check auth logs.
elena: Running query now for 5xx grouped by upstream and error class: `logs query "service:api-gateway env:hosted-infer status>=500 | group_by([upstream, status], count()) | sort_desc(count)"` -> top upstream is infer-proxy-01 and majority are 502/504 handshake/timeouts. Traces for those requests are sparse.
maria.sre: That trace gap is concerning. Run Jaeger search for trace IDs from logs, looks like many are missing. Could be sampling or proxy not propagating x-trace-id on timeout code path.
observability-bot: Tracing coverage for gateway spans dropped from 95% -> 62% in the 10m window. Possible cause: proxy 503 path bypasses tracer.
jordan: Repro steps from staging: I hit the gateway with a tight concurrency loop (100 concurrent small requests) to infer-proxy-01, saw connection resets and 502s at ~70 concurrency. Sharing minimal repro: ```bash
for i in {1..100}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"ok"}' https://staging-api.redwood/v1/generate &
done
wait
```
ashwin: Good repro. Can someone capture `tcpdump` on infer-proxy-01 when hitting it? Suspect upstream handshake backlog. Also capture `ss -s` and `netstat -anp` to see socket states.
elena: Collected logs from infer-proxy-01: lots of `TLS handshake timeout` and `upstream read timeout` around 1802003400-1802003500. Stack glimpses show worker threads saturated.
maria.sre: Metrics: connection queue length spiked, worker CPU ~92%, GPU workers unaffected. Suggests proxy layer bottleneck. Possible causes: rate-limiter misconfig, auth plugin doing blocking I/O after token introspection.
jordan: I grepped auth plugin logs — token introspection endpoint had occasional 500s around the same time from authz-service. That caused auth plugin to block and backpressure.
ryan-support: Customer reported billing errors too (their requests retried -> duplicated usage). They want a playbook to avoid double-billing when retries cause duplicate accepted requests.
maria.sre: Action items: 1) roll back last authz-service deploy to restore introspection stability (ashwin) 2) add defensive timeout on auth plugin to fail-fast (jordan) 3) enable proxy circuit-breaker for upstream infer nodes (elena) 4) follow-up on billing dedup strategy with support (ryan) 5) patch tracing to ensure trace ids emitted on timeout path (observability team).
ashwin: Rolling back authz-service now (deploy id: authz-2027-03-17-22). Will monitor.
elena: Enabling proxy short-circuit circuit-breaker on infer-proxy-01/02 in us-west-2. Patch applied to canary (infer-proxy-02).
jordan: Added 150ms timeout to local token introspect call in auth plugin and instrumented metrics. Will PR to main.
maria.sre: Realtime: 5xx fraction dropping to 1.2% after rollback + circuit-breaker. P99 latency improving. Tracing coverage starting to recover.
ryan-support: Telling customer we've mitigated, will follow up on billing credits and recommend exponential backoff + idempotency-key.
observability-bot: Incident update: mitigation in place, monitoring for 30m.
elena: Open PRs and runbook updates: https://git.redwood/platform/ops/runbooks/incident-authz-proxy
maria.sre: Thanks everyone. Postmortem draft please - include timeline, root cause (authz introspect 500s -> auth plugin blocking -> proxy worker saturation -> 5xx + tracing gaps), customer impact, and remediation (timeboxed rollback, fail-fast auth plugin, proxy circuit-breaker, billing dedupe guidance). Assigning owners: postmortem (maria.sre), billing follow-up (ryan-support), auth fix (jordan), proxy config (elena), tracing patch (observability).
ashwin: Confirmed last_message_ts update at 1802003876. Closing initial triage.
